verdict.rationale: Capacities documents that AI features are fully opt-in and that, if AI is not activated, no space data is shared with any third-party AI services. That gives users a way to keep their data away from AI providers. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses model training, and keeping data safe this way means giving up AI features entirely. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment from Capacities or its AI providers, a no-training guarantee when AI is enabled, and independent corroboration.
